remarks: Live in style in the Heart of Saugatuck!! The Brand-New Kitchen includes upscale cabinets, counters, and stainless dishwasher and refrigerator. Ideal blend of comfort and convenience. Meticulously maintained unit, nestled mere minutes from Westport train, shops, restaurants, public golf course, beach, and both 95 and the Merritt. Freshly painted and deep-cleaned interior space is bathed in natural light, and boasts ample room to entertain or just chill. Well-located to access Westport's vibrant Downtown. This Rental is a commuter's dream. The LR, BR and Bath are all spacious and suffused with natural light. HVAC system includes a programmable thermostat, to maximize energy efficiency, while controlling expense. Conveniently located washer and dryer. All poised to ensure your comfort and efficiency. Easy to clean, healthy, and elegant hardwood and tile flooring. As a resident, you'll benefit from included trash removal and snowplowing, as well as One Space in the off-street parking lot, just steps from the building front door. Embrace all the wonderful cultural amenities the Fairfield County lifestyle has to offer!! Don't miss this exceptional opportunity to make this Westport gem your new home. The previous tenant stayed for 9 years! Please Note: There is ONE off street parking space with this rental.
